description: This file defines a Java interface named TimeAxisTranslator, which provides methods for converting between time values and screen coordinates, as well as retrieving maximum and minimum time bounds.

classes.name: TimeAxisTranslator
classes.description: A Java interface for translating time values to screen coordinates and vice versa, used in wave or graph rendering components.

methods.name: timeToScreen
methods.description: Converts a time value to a screen coordinate given the width of the display area.

methods.name: screenToTime
methods.description: Converts a screen coordinate back to a time value based on the display width.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum time value that can be represented.

methods.name: getMinTime
methods.description: Returns the minimum time value that can be represented.
